jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management, AEC Data
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101506

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking an exceptional product leader to shape the future of how the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry creates, connects, and uses design and engineering data.

As Sr. Director of Product Management for AEC Data, you will lead the strategy for a portfolio of data products and capabilities powering Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud and our broader AEC ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape a critical foundation for Autodesk's next generation of AEC products, unlocking new ways for customers and developers to work with connected design and engineering data.

We are looking for a leader with outstanding product judgment, deep experience building data products and platforms, and a proven ability to translate complex technology into customer and business value. You will lead a team of product managers and work across Autodesk's product and engineering organizations to drive strategy, alignment, and results.

This is a global, hybrid role based in the US, Canada, or UK, reporting to the VP of AEC Data, with travel up to 25%.

Primary Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Execution

Drive the strategy for context-rich AEC data capabilities that connect domain entities, relationships, and semantics, enabling intelligent applications, connected workflows, and AI-powered experiences.
Own product priorities and roadmaps, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform investments.
Lead product discovery, ensuring teams focus on meaningful customer problems and validate opportunities before committing to solutions.
Establish clear success metrics and drive accountability for product adoption, customer outcomes, and business impact.
Make strategic product and investment trade-offs, influencing executive stakeholders and cross-functional leaders.

Data Products & Platforms

Lead the development of data products and platform capabilities that make complex AEC data accessible, interoperable, and reusable across applications and workflows.
Apply strong product thinking to data models, APIs, and services, treating them as products with clear customers, value propositions, and measurable outcomes.
Partner with engineering leadership to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term architectural evolution.
Drive adoption of shared data capabilities across Autodesk products, customers, and developer ecosystems.

Leadership & Influence

Build and lead a high-performing product management organization, developing product leaders and establishing a culture of strong product judgment, customer focus, and accountability.
Establish rigorous prioritization, continuous discovery, and outcome-driven product management practices.
Lead through influence across Autodesk's product, engineering, and business organizations to align priorities and deliver results
Engage with customers, partners, and senior executives to communicate product vision and shape strategic direction.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of software product management experience, including leadership of complex enterprise software, platform, or data products.
5+ years leading and developing product management teams.
Demonstrated success building product data platforms or capabilities that model, connect, manage, and expose complex domain data across applications, including domain data models, APIs, and shared data services.
Proven ability to define product strategy, identify customer opportunities, make investment trade-offs, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Strong product discovery skills and experience driving products from concept through adoption and growth.
Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into compelling customer value and business opportunities.
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex product strategies, influence executive decisions, and inspire alignment across technical, business, and customer audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building data products and capabilities involving complex domain-specific data (e.g., engineering, design, manufacturing), including context graphs, knowledge graphs, semantic data models, or similar approaches to representing and connecting data relationships.
Understanding of AEC workflows, BIM, and industry data standards such as IFC.
Experience building platform ecosystems and driving adoption across multiple product teams or external developers.
Familiarity with domain modeling, interoperability, data lifecycle management, and AI-enabled product capabilities.
MBA or equivalent business leadership experience.

Learn More

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

jobs.title: Sr Director, Business Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Serves as a key strategic partner to the Vice President of Operations and the Site Leadership Team (SLT), enabling the Gilead Alberta site to achieve its short- and long-term business objectives through strong strategy deployment, operational discipline, organizational change management, communication, digital enablement, and operational excellence.
Accountable for translating site, Pharmaceutical Development and Manufacturing (PDM), and enterprise priorities into actionable plans, governance routines, performance management systems, and cross-functional execution mechanisms.
Provides leadership across multiple strategic and operational workstreams and ensures alignment between business priorities, resources, organizational capability, and site performance.
Responsible for multi-function strategic planning
Institutes key processes necessary to achieve long and short-term strategic goals.
Anticipates shifts in industry trends and regulatory environment that will impact Gilead’s business needs and positions the function to respond accordingly.
Works with the SLT to establish and publish Key Performance Indicators.

Strategy Development and Implementation

Acts as key strategic advisor, leading the development and execution of short- and long-range strategic plans in alignment with PDM and PDM Manufacturing strategy and ambition, company goals, market trends and in partnership with the SLT.
Provides insight in developing, prioritization and communicating site-wide priorities and initiatives. Creates buy-in for the business plans and vision for the future to ensure goals are aligned and achieved.
Develops plans to translate strategic objectives into tactical implementation of new technologies and processes to enhance production efficiency.
Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress and identify areas for further optimization.
Builds strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and alignment on strategic and operational priorities.
Supports the development of a culture that aligns with the company values, encouraging growth and learning mindset while ensuring accountability and retaining key talent in a positive environment.

Organization Change Management & Communication

Leads the organizational change management strategy for major site initiatives, ensuring business changes are effectively planned, communicated, adopted, and sustained.
Communicates manufacturing site strategy and progress to the SLT, including regular updates on performance metrics.
Partners with the VP of Operations, SLT, HR and functional leaders to ensure messaging is aligned, timely, transparent, and connected to site values and strategic pillars.
Develops communication plans and ensures effective communication strategies are in place within the organization, including two-way communication channels.
Accountable for the success of formal organizational change management impacting all business units.
Strengthens site-wide change readiness by building leader capability in communication, stakeholder engagement, and change adoption.
Supports leaders in translating complex business changes into practical, audience-specific messages that promote understanding, engagement, and ownership.

Operational Excellence

Develops and leads the Alberta operational excellence strategy in alignment with site priorities, business needs, and enterprise goals.
Champions continuous improvement methodologies and establishes sustainable processes that improve productivity and effectiveness.
Manages multiple cross-functional projects.
Conducts process analysis, identifies bottlenecks and inefficiencies, and designs and implements process improvement solutions using methodologies like Lean Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement frameworks.
Utilizes data analytics to measure performance, identify trends, and track progress on improvement initiatives.
Supports a high-performing cross-functional team of operational excellence professionals, providing coaching and development opportunities.
Works closely with cross-functional teams across departments to identify and implement operational improvements.
Fosters a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging employee engagement and feedback on process improvement opportunities.
Ensures operational excellence initiatives are supported by appropriate change management, communication, training, adoption, and sustainment plans.

Experience Requirements

BS Degree and 14 years of experience

OR

Master's Degree and 12 years of experience

OR

PhD and 12 years of experience

People Leader Accountabilities

Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

jobs.title: Program Director, Bell AI Fabric
jobs.description:
Req Id:
431516

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan.

As Program Director, you will be accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the national data centre build program—orchestrating scope, schedule, budget, and cross-functional execution across multiple concurrent sites. You'll be the integrating force connecting construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls into one predictable, well-governed program, ensuring Bell delivers these mission-critical facilities on time, on budget, and to standard as the initiative scales aggressively nationally.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for the national data centre build program, integrating scope, schedule, budget, and quality across multiple concurrent sites.
Orchestrate cross-functional execution across construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls, ensuring alignment to program objectives.
Establish and govern the program delivery framework—stage gates, milestones, governance cadence, and decision rights—across the portfolio.
Own the integrated master schedule and program-level budget, driving predictability, transparency, and schedule discipline across all builds.
Lead program-level risk management, change governance, and interdependency management, escalating and resolving systemic issues before they impact delivery.
Provide executive-level program reporting to AI Fabric and Capital Programs leadership, translating complex delivery status into clear, decision-ready insight.
Manage program financials, forecasting, and capital planning in partnership with finance and program controls.
Drive resource planning and prioritization across sites, balancing competing demands as the program scales
Build and mature Bell's program delivery capability at a formative stage, embedding repeatable processes, playbooks, and lessons learned across the fleet.
Serve as a senior point of escalation and executive interface for site directors, functional leads, and external delivery partners.

Critical Qualifications

15+ years leading large-scale capital program delivery, with direct experience on hyperscale or mission-critical data centres (multi-site / multi-billion-dollar portfolios preferred)
Proven track record owning end-to-end program delivery across multiple concurrent construction projects, not just single-project management.
Deep command of program management disciplines—integrated master scheduling, budget/cost control, risk management, and change governance.
Strong understanding of the full data centre delivery lifecycle—construction, engineering, MEP, and commissioning through to operational handover.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and align diverse cross-functional teams and external delivery partners.
Expertise in program governance, stage-gate frameworks, and executive reporting.
Exceptional executive presence, able to influence and challenge senior engineering, construction, finance, and executive leaders.
Experience building and maturing a program delivery organization from a formative stage.
Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; PMP/PgMP, P.Eng., or equivalent strongly preferred.
Willingness to travel nationally between build locations as the portfolio scales.

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is seeking a transformational Area Vice President, Sales, Financial Services - CANADA ENTERPRISE to serve as a key member and business leader to the Sales Leadership Team. This Area Vice President will be responsible for inspirational sales leadership and management of growth within the Financial Services Business Unit (Enterprise) in Canada, through rapidly growing top-line revenues and driving new business through the implementation of scalable, repeatable, structured systems and processes.

Additionally, this leader will serve as a strong Business Leader, Customer Partner, and Talent Multiplier, and will have the personal drive and commitment to both understand and successfully navigate a fast-growing, global company striving towards continued market domination in an evolving marketplace.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Will help to set and implement Salesforce’s Canada Financial Services sales strategy. This executive will assume the leadership of a growing sales organization including Regional Vice Presidents (RVP), and Account Executives (AE) to help steer complex deal transactions
Set and execute an ambitious customer acquisition strategy to generate growth in revenue and bookings

Act as a strategic thought leader and advisor to the SVP, Financial Services
Work closely with functions and other executives across the organization to establish and develop a strong and collaborative partnership to ensure continued success
Manage the overall sales process, set appropriate metrics for sales funnel management
Plan and manage at both the strategic and operational levels

1st or 2nd line leadership experience leading teams in strategic sales
Deep industry expertise in the Financial Services sector
Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals
Solid track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high performing sales organizations
12+ years in software and/or applications sales (ideally in a CRM, ERP and/or otherwise relevant software company), selling primarily to the CxO level
Proven ability to drive transformational change across a large organization: understands the drivers of how to change a culture, assess performance, continuously refresh a sales organization and build capability
Excellent operational and analytical abilities
Consistent track record of building satisfied, loyal and referenceable customers
Dynamic and strong sales execution mindset with a passion for a fast-paced growing environment
Shown success working within a highly matrixed organization and establishing relationships across all functions
Champions diversity of team, thought, and opinion with a demonstrated ability to work effectively and collaboratively with diverse team members
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on theValues & Behaviors for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Experience selling cloud based enterprise applications is strongly preferred

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Strategy
jobs.description:
Agency

Omnicom Precision Marketing

Job Function

Strategy and Planning

Job Subfunction

Research and Insights

Job Description

WHO WE ARE:

We are TRACK – a member of the RAPP family – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As a global, next-generation precision marketing agency, we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations. We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

How We Do It

At TRACK, our fearless super connectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning. 

Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients. 

Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group (OPMG), RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets. The TRACK team makes up 100 of those.

Your Role

We’re looking for a strategically minded individual with a proven record of building high performing customer experiences and CRM journeys for world-class brands. You will lead with excellence in the day-to-day strategic delivery alongside a team of strategists.

Your industry and CRM background will equip you to create a high standard for deliverables. Your strategic prowess will uncover opportunities to design a path forward and deliver impactful work with results. Your ability to create innovative communications plans will spark new ideas and thoughtfully connect with the end-customer.

This is an 18-month contract, with the possibility of conversion to a permanent position.

Your Responsibilities

Oversee the development of strategic initiatives and deliverables for clients.
Create communication strategies/CRM strategies to identify, capture, and nurture customers across the entire decision-making process.
Work collaboratively in an interagency team model to build customer experience programs that leverage a multitude of channels, such as web, email, mobile, and media.
Develop content strategies that can personalize at scale to engage different types of customers and compel them to act.
Distill primary and secondary research into customer beliefs, attitudes, and barriers to build compelling personas and actionable user journeys.
Unearth novel insights that fuel strategic plans and briefs.
Guide team of more junior strategist roles with your knowledge and expertise.
Lead the creative briefing process and partner with Creative team to inspire great work.
Identify the need to initiate current state analyses including but not limited to market analyses and competitive analyses.
Work collaboratively with the Marketing Sciences team to develop learning agendas, leverage data and data architecture and explore opportunities for data capture optimization.
Collaborate closely with other vendors and agency partners to ensure strategic consistency across program elements.
Present strategic recommendations to clients.

Required Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
7+ years of experience in strategic planning at an agency, CRM/CXM and/or digital marketing.
Strong knowledge of CRM and prior experience in developing a strategic plan for a campaign.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects with various deadlines simultaneously.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and development of PowerPoint or Keynote presentations.
Excellent writing and editing skills with strict attention to detail.

jobs.description:
Vice President, Fund Finance, Global Credit Markets 

A career as a Vice President in the Fund Finance, Global Credit Markets team at National Bank of Canada Capital Markets means acting as a trusted advisor to financial institution clients while leading the structuring, execution, and origination of complex financing transactions. 
In this role, you will leverage your expertise in corporate lending, credit analysis, capital markets, and relationship management to support the growth of the Fund Finance franchise across Canada and internationally. You will work closely with clients and internal partners to develop tailored financing solutions and deliver strategic advice to banks, insurance companies, asset managers, specialty finance companies, and other financial institution clients. 
The position is suited to an experienced finance professional with strong analytical capabilities, proven transaction execution experience, and the ability to build and manage senior client relationships. 
Your Job 

Lead the origination, analysis, structuring, and execution of complex corporate lending and credit-based financing transactions for Financial Institution clients. 
Build and manage client relationships, participate in business development initiatives, and lead client meetings, presentations, and pitch opportunities alongside senior members of the team. 
Oversee financial, credit, and industry analysis, while leading the preparation and presentation of credit recommendations and transaction materials used for internal approval processes and client discussions. 
Monitor portfolio performance, market conditions, and key industry trends impacting the Financial Institutions sector, providing strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders. 
Work closely with colleagues across Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Loan Syndications, Debt Capital Markets, Derivatives, and Risk Management to deliver integrated financing solutions and successfully execute transactions.
Mentor and develop Analysts and Associates, promote best practices across the team, and contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes and analytical frameworks.
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the FIG sector and represent the team internally and externally as a trusted advisor and industry specialist. 

Your Team 

This position reports to the Managing Director & Head, Financial Institutions Group (FIG) and Fund Finance, Global Credit Markets. Based in Toronto, the Fund finance team works closely with Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Debt Capital Markets, Loan Syndications, M&A, Derivatives, and Risk Management teams to deliver comprehensive financing solutions to clients across the financial institutions sector. 
Our team is recognized for its collaborative culture, entrepreneurial mindset, and deep sector expertise. We offer opportunities to work on sophisticated transactions while developing strong client relationships and industry knowledge. 
Our training programs combine on-the-job learning with access to experienced professionals from across National Bank of Canada, allowing you to continuously develop your leadership, advisory, and transaction execution capabilities. 
Prerequisites 

Undergraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 
5–8+ years of relevant experience in corporate banking, fund finance coverage, global credit markets, leveraged finance, investment banking, or related fields. 
Strong experience analyzing and structuring corporate lending and financing transactions. 
Deep understanding of financial institution business models, credit fundamentals, and capital structures. 
Advanced financial modeling and credit analysis capabilities. 
Proven ability to manage multiple complex transactions simultaneously with limited supervision. 
Experience preparing and presenting detailed credit recommendations and client presentations. 
Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills 
CFA, CPA, MBA, or other relevant professional designation is considered a strong asset. 
Excellent relationship management and business development skills. 
Demonstrated leadership, mentorship, and team collaboration experience. 

Languages: English
Required skills: Agile Leadership, Analytical Skills, Appropriations, Capital Markets, Client Development, Client Relations, Data Analysis, Detail-oriented, Financial Institutions, Financial Modeling, Financial Structuring, Funding, Leadership, Mentoring, Presentations

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan.

As Program Director, you will be accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the national data centre build program—orchestrating scope, schedule, budget, and cross-functional execution across multiple concurrent sites. You'll be the integrating force connecting construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls into one predictable, well-governed program, ensuring Bell delivers these mission-critical facilities on time, on budget, and to standard as the initiative scales aggressively nationally.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for the national data centre build program, integrating scope, schedule, budget, and quality across multiple concurrent sites.
Orchestrate cross-functional execution across construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls, ensuring alignment to program objectives.
Establish and govern the program delivery framework—stage gates, milestones, governance cadence, and decision rights—across the portfolio.
Own the integrated master schedule and program-level budget, driving predictability, transparency, and schedule discipline across all builds.
Lead program-level risk management, change governance, and interdependency management, escalating and resolving systemic issues before they impact delivery.
Provide executive-level program reporting to AI Fabric and Capital Programs leadership, translating complex delivery status into clear, decision-ready insight.
Manage program financials, forecasting, and capital planning in partnership with finance and program controls.
Drive resource planning and prioritization across sites, balancing competing demands as the program scales
Build and mature Bell's program delivery capability at a formative stage, embedding repeatable processes, playbooks, and lessons learned across the fleet.
Serve as a senior point of escalation and executive interface for site directors, functional leads, and external delivery partners.

Critical Qualifications

15+ years leading large-scale capital program delivery, with direct experience on hyperscale or mission-critical data centres (multi-site / multi-billion-dollar portfolios preferred)
Proven track record owning end-to-end program delivery across multiple concurrent construction projects, not just single-project management.
Deep command of program management disciplines—integrated master scheduling, budget/cost control, risk management, and change governance.
Strong understanding of the full data centre delivery lifecycle—construction, engineering, MEP, and commissioning through to operational handover.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and align diverse cross-functional teams and external delivery partners.
Expertise in program governance, stage-gate frameworks, and executive reporting.
Exceptional executive presence, able to influence and challenge senior engineering, construction, finance, and executive leaders.
Experience building and maturing a program delivery organization from a formative stage.
Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; PMP/PgMP, P.Eng., or equivalent strongly preferred.
Willingness to travel nationally between build locations as the portfolio scales.
